test_objective: Test system handling of empty input query

system_response.description: System silently ignores empty query without producing any visible response, error message, or state change

robustness_assessment.error_prevention: PASS - No crash or error state
robustness_assessment.user_feedback: FAIL - No indication that query was rejected or why

issues_identified.issue: No user feedback on empty query submission
issues_identified.description: User receives no indication that empty queries are invalid or that they should enter text
issues_identified.recommendation: Add validation message like 'Please enter a query' or disable Analyze button when input is empty

conclusion.stability: STABLE - System does not crash or error on empty input
conclusion.ux_impact: MINOR - User may be confused why nothing happens
conclusion.overall_rating: ACCEPTABLE - Graceful degradation but lacks user feedback
